subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should the iOS phone Control tab continue with the current native SwiftUI List direction, or should maintainers sponsor this card-based Chat/Talk redesign after a rebase?
rationale: The linked feature issue is explicitly product/design-oriented, current main has since landed overlapping native-list and typography work, and automation cannot decide the permanent iOS visual direction.

options.title: Keep the native-list direction
options.body: Decline or close this card-based PR and route any remaining Control polish into narrower native-list follow-ups.

options.title: Sponsor the card redesign
options.body: Ask for a rebase on current main, OpenClawType typography, preserved routing, and real simulator proof before design review.

options.title: Request a narrower experiment
options.body: Keep the feature issue open but ask for screenshots or a prototype that compares against the current native-list baseline before accepting code changes.

recommendation.title: Keep the native-list direction
recommendation.body: Decline or close this card-based PR and route any remaining Control polish into narrower native-list follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete most recently changed the overlapping iOS Control/Talk visual hierarchy and native-interface direction.
